PostpartumRecovery.6: Muviri wako unoda nguva: chii chinenge chiri chakanaka pashure pokubereka.
PostpartumRecovery.12: Kufambisa uye kutangazve mabasa zvishoma nezvishoma
PostpartumRecovery.22: Kufambisa uye kutangazve mabasa zvishoma nezvishoma
PostpartumRecovery.28: Nguva yokusununguka pashure pokuberekwa kwevana haisi mazuva mashomanana chete: muviri, marwadzo ezuva nezuva, uye manzwiro zvinogona kuramba zvichikura zvishoma nezvishoma mumavhiki anotevera.
PostpartumRecovery.29: ⁇ quarantaine ⁇  ishoko renzvimbo rinowanzoshandiswa kutsanangura mavhiki okutanga ekudzoka. Inogona kuva chiyeuchidzo chakanaka: mushure mokunge pamuviri uye pakuberekwa, zvakakodzera kuderedza uye kupa muviri nguva.
PostpartumRecovery.31: Kudzoka kunobatanidza muviri, asiwo kurara, simba, kuronga kwezuva nezuva, uye kuwirirana kwemanzwiro kumatanho matsva oupenyu.
PostpartumRecovery.32: Mazuva okutanga anogona kuva akaoma. Zororo, kutarisira kwokutanga, uye kujairana nenhanho itsva kazhinji ndizvo zvinonyanya kukosha.
PostpartumRecovery.34: Kuita basa uye kuzorora kunobatsira muviri kuti uwanezve zvishoma nezvishoma.
PostpartumRecovery.36: Kudya nguva dzose nokunwa zvinoenderana nezvinodiwa zvako kunobatsira kupora zuva nezuva.
PostpartumRecovery.38: Kugamuchira betsero kunoita kuti zvive nyore kuchengetedza simba nokuda kwokurapwa kunokosha uye kupora.
PostpartumRecovery.40: Dzokerai zvishoma nezvishoma kumativi enyu uye mabasa enyu, muchiremekedza mamiriro enyu ezvinhu uye zvamunonyatsogadzikana.
PostpartumRecovery.45: Kuoma kwezviratidzo uye nguva yazvo zvinogona kusiyana-siyana zvichienderana nemunhu mumwe nomumwe. Chinokosha ndechokucherechedza kuti zvinochinja sei uye kutsvaka mazano kana kuchinja kuchiita sekunetsa kana kuti kusingawanzoitiki.
PostpartumRecovery.46: Munguva yokusununguka, tsika duku dzakanaka dzinobatsira kupfuura kuita zvinhu zvinorema.
PostpartumRecovery.47: Ronga nguva dzokuzorora dzokunyatsorara kana zvichibvira.
PostpartumRecovery.48: Kumbira kubatsirwa nemabasa ezuva nezuva uye zvokudya.
PostpartumRecovery.49: Inwa nguva dzose uye udye zvakasiyana-siyana.
PostpartumRecovery.51: Ramba uchiita zvinhu zvishoma nezvishoma, usingaiti zvose pakarepo.
PostpartumRecovery.53: Kuzvipoteredza nerutsigiro uye kugamuchira rubatsiro hakusi kushamisira.
PostpartumRecovery.54: Kuenderera mberi nemabasa kunogona kuitika nhanho nhanho, zvichibva pakunyaradzwa, simba, uye mazano akagamuchirwa pashure pokubereka.
PostpartumRecovery.55: Kana uchida kuita mabasa akaoma, zvakanaka kuti ufambire mberi usingapindi uye kuti uone zviratidzo kana kuti kusagadzikana.
PostpartumRecovery.57: Kusagadzikana kunowedzera panguva yebasa chimwe chikonzero chokunonoka uye, kana zvichidiwa, kutsvaka mazano akanyatsokodzera usati waenderera mberi kana kuti kuwedzera simba.
PostpartumRecovery.58: Kurara kunogona kuva kusiri kurongeka pashure pokubereka. Kuneta kwakawanda kunogona kukanganisa simba, pfungwa, uye mafungiro.
PostpartumRecovery.62: Kudzoka zvishoma nezvishoma uye kutanga kwemaitiro matsva.
PostpartumRecovery.64: Ongorora kufambira mberi kwepfungwa dzokudzorera uye kurukura nezvekuenderera mberi nemabasa zvishoma nezvishoma.
PostpartumRecovery.65: Nguva yokusununguka inogona kuita kuti munhu anzwe zvinhu zvakawanda zvinoti: mufaro, kunetseka, kuneta, kunzwa zviri nani, kana kuti kunzwa kuti haasi kuzokwanisa kuita chimwe chinhu.
PostpartumRecovery.66: Kutaura nemunhu waunovimba naye kana kuti kune nyanzvi kunogona kubatsira kana manzwiro achioma kubata kana kuti achitora nzvimbo yakawanda muupenyu hwezuva nezuva.
PostpartumRecovery.68: Hapana chikonzero chokumirira kusvikira wanyatsopera simba kana kuti wanyanya kutaura zvauri kunzwa uye kutsvaka rubatsiro.
PostpartumRecovery.69: Mamwe mamiriro ezvinhu akakodzera kukurukurwa nenyanzvi yeutano, kunyanya kana akaipa, achiramba aripo, kana kuti achiita kuti munhu anyanye kunetseka.
PostpartumRecovery.71: Kurwadziwa kana kusagadzikana kunowedzera panzvimbo pokuvandudza kunoda zano rehunyanzvi.
PostpartumRecovery.73: Kubuda ropa kunongoerekana kwawedzera kana kuti kusingawanzoitiki kunofanira kutaurwa kune chiremba.
PostpartumRecovery.75: Kana kushushikana kwepfungwa kuchitora nzvimbo yakawanda kana kuti kuchiita kuti upenyu hwezuva nezuva huve hwakaoma, zvinokosha kuti utaure nezvazvo uye ukumbire kutsigirwa.
PostpartumRecovery.77: Kana usina chokwadi chokuti uchapora, kukumbira mazano kunokubatsira kuwana mazano akakodzera mamiriro ako ezvinhu.
PostpartumRecovery.78: Kuonana kunotevera mukana wokukurukura nezvokupora, zviratidzo, kutangazve mabasa, uye mibvunzo yasara. Kugadzirira mibvunzo mishomanana pachine nguva kunogona kubatsira kuona kuti hapana chinokanganwika.
PostpartumRecovery.80: Kuvandudzwa kwangu kuri kufambira mberi sezvinotarisirwa nokuda kwemamiriro angu ezvinhu here?
PostpartumRecovery.84: Ndinoda mazano kana kuti kurapwa here?
PostpartumRecovery.85: Kudzoka pashure pokubereka kunongoitika zvishoma nezvishoma uye kunosiyana kune mumwe nomumwe.
PostpartumRecovery.86: Kuzorora uye kutsigirwa kunogona kuva chikamu chinokosha chokupora.
PostpartumRecovery.87: Kuchinja kwemuviri, kurara, uye manzwiro zvinogona kuchinja mumavhiki.
PostpartumRecovery.88: Kudzokera kumitambo zvishoma nezvishoma kunokubatsira kuti uremekedze simba rako uye kugadzikana kwako.
PostpartumRecovery.89: Kana ukaona chiratidzo chisingawanzoitiki, chinoramba chichiitika, kana kuti chinonetsa, kutsvaka zano idanho rakanaka.
PostpartumRecovery.91: Kudzoka hakusi rudzi. Kufambira mberi zvishoma nezvishoma, kuremekedza zvaunoda, uye kukumbira rubatsiro kana zvichidiwa zvinoitwa matanho anokosha.
PostpartumRecovery.92: Nyaya ino inoitira kuti vanhu vazive uye haitsivi mazano emurapi anopiwa munhu oga.

PrayerDuringMenstruation.6: Nei minyengetero yetsika ichimiswa panguva ino, uye kuti tingararama sei nguva iyi takadzikama.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.8: AWA haibudisi fatwa kana kutonga kwechitendero kwakagadzirirwa.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.11: Hapana kunyengeterera kunenge kwakanganwa, kusiyana nokutsanya
PrayerDuringMenstruation.14: Munguva yemwedzi, basa rokunyengetera (salat) rinomiswa: mukadzi haafaniri kunyengetera panguva iyi.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.15: Kurambidzwa uku hakurevi kurega kutenda kana kuti kutadza kuita zvechitendero.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.17: Nguva iyi inogona kuswedera pedyo norugare: haibvunzi kukosha kwokutenda kwomunhu kana kuti kurongeka kwechiito chake chechitendero.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.18: Kana nguva yokunamata ichitanga, inenge ichitenderera: haidi kupera kana kuti kugadzirwa; asi, panopera nguva yokunamata, munamato unotangazve pashure pechiitiko chikuru chokunatswa.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.19: Kusiyana nokutsanya kweRamadan, uko mazuva asina kupera pamwedzi anoitwa gare gare (qadaa), minamato isina kupera nekuda kwechikonzero chimwe chete ichi kazhinji haiperi gare gare. Musiyano uyu unotsanangurwa nehunhu hwezviito zviviri zvekunamata izvi: munamato chiito chezuva nezuva chinozadziswa kanoverengeka pazuva, nepo kutsanya kwegore negore uye kunongedzerwa pamwedzi chaiwo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.20: Kusiyanisa uku kunogona kushamisa kana munhu akatanga kuwana fiqh. Izvi hazvirevi kuti munyengetero hauna zvaunoreva: kutevera kusunungurwa sezvakanyorwa pachako, kunobatanidzwa zvizere mukunamata.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.21: Kusanyengetera panguva yokushaya nguva hakurevi kuti munhu ari kure nomudzimu wake.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.31: Dzimwe tsika, dzakadai sokudzokorora kana kuti kubata zvakananga neKoran, dzinogona kuva nemibvunzo yakasiyana zvichienderana nechikoro chemutemo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.33: Munyengetero wakamiswa panguva yenguva yomwedzi unobvumirwa kuva wakasununguka, unofanira kuongororwa pasina mhosva.

PregnancyExercise.6: Kugara uchishanda zvishoma nezvishoma, wakachengeteka, mumwedzi mitatu.
PregnancyExercise.13: Kufamba, kushambira, uye kuita yoga isati yaberekwa zvinowanzokurudzirwa panguva yose yokusununguka, zvichienderana nemanzwiro ako.
PregnancyExercise.17: Dzivisa mitambo ine simba rakakura kana zviitiko zvine njodzi yekudonha, kunyanya kubva pamwedzi wechipiri zvichienda mberi:
PregnancyExercise.18: Mitambo ine simba rakakura (kumhanya kwakanyanya, mitambo yemakwikwi inokurumidza)
PregnancyExercise.19: Mabasa ane ngozi yekudonha (kuchamhama, kukwira mabhiza, kuchovha bhasikoro munzvimbo dzisina kugadzikana)
PregnancyExercise.21: Kuita basa rakaoma uri kumusoro kana kuti uchipisa zvikuru
PregnancyExercise.23: Kurwadziwa, kubuda ropa, kana kuti kuderera paunenge uchishanda nesimba
PregnancyExercise.25: Nguva dzose teerera zviratidzo zvomuviri wako uye taura nemubereki wako kana kuti chiremba usati watanga kana kuchinja basa.
PregnancyExercise.27: Kuita basa rakanaka nguva dzose kunobatsira pamuviri: chinokosha ndechokuchinja simba rako kuti rienderane nechimwe nechimwe uye kuti unonzwa sei.

PregnancyWeekly.19: Nguva yechipiri inowanzova yakaoma zvikuru, uye mwana paanenge ava kufamba.

PregnancyWeekly.23: Kuwedzeredzwa uku kunowanzova kusingawirirani uye hakurwadza zvikuru; kunosiyana nokuwedzeredzwa kwokubereka.

PregnancyWeekly.32: Zviratidzo zvomuviri zvinoda kurapwa nokukurumidza, pasinei nokuti mwedzi wacho uri mumwedzi upi:
PregnancyWeekly.36: Kunetseka kwakakomba kwemusoro kana kuti kusanzwisisa
PregnancyWeekly.39: Kutenderera kwegore rimwe nerimwe kunounza kuchinja kwaro: kuziva izvi pachine nguva kunokubatsira kuti unzwe zviri nani nezvenguva imwe neimwe, pasina kutsiva kugara uchishanyira mubereki wako kana kuti chiremba.

RamadanFasting.6: Mazano anoshanda uye mazano ekudzidzisa kuti urarame mwedzi weRamadan uchiri mudumbu, uine rugare.
RamadanFasting.8: AWA haibudisi fatwa kana kutonga kwechitendero kwakagadzirirwa.
RamadanFasting.10: Kuzvinyima zvokudya kwakamiswa panguva yawakaenda kumwedzi
RamadanFasting.14: Munguva yako, kutsanya hakurevi basa: nguva iyi inoisa mukadzi mumamiriro ezvinhu umo zviito zvakawanda zvokunamata, kusanganisira kutsanya, zvinomiswa kwenguva pfupi.
RamadanFasting.15: Kuisa nguva yako yokutsanya hakurevi kuti uri kure nechitendero chako; inongova nguva yakatarwa, wozotangazve kuita zvawo nguva yako yapera, pasina kutenda kunorasika.
RamadanFasting.17: Nguva iyi inogonawo kuonekwa seimwe nguva mukati memwedzi, apo ukama hwomudzimu hunoramba huchiratidzwa nedzimwe nzira, pasina kutsanya.
RamadanFasting.19: Mamiriro ezvinhu aya haafaniri kuongororwa nemhosva: chikamu chemuviri wemhuka uye chinotsanangurwa netsika dzechitendero pachayo.
RamadanFasting.20: Kusatsanya hakurevi kuti hausi mumwedzi weRamadan.
RamadanFasting.30: Izvi zviito zviduku, kunyange zvakapusa, zvinokubatsira kuramba wakabatana zvakakwana nomudzimu wemwedzi, pasinei nemamiriro ako ezvinhu.
RamadanFasting.31: Kuongorora mazuva ako okuenda kumwedzi muRamadan kunoita kuti zvive nyore pashure pacho kuverenga nhamba yemazuva okuita (qadaa), uye kunodzivisa kuvimba nepfungwa kana mwedzi wapera.
RamadanFasting.32: Cherechedza musi wezuva rimwe nerimwe risina kutsanya paunenge uchienda
RamadanFasting.33: Shandisa karenda, purogiramu, kana kuti bhuku rakanyatsotarisirwa
RamadanFasting.34: Ita cheki nokukurumidza pakupera kwemwedzi kuti uone kuti uwandu hwacho hwakawanda sei
RamadanFasting.36: AWA inogona kukubatsira kuteedzera kutenderera kwako muRamadan, saka unogona kuwana mashoko aya nyore nyore gare gare.
RamadanFasting.38: Mashoko chaiwo okuita kuti mazuva asina kukwana (nguva, mamiriro ezvinhu chaiwo akadai sokubata pamuviri kana kuyamwisa) anogona kusiyana zvichienderana nechikoro chemutemo.
RamadanFasting.40: Kuzvinyima zvokudya panguva dzako dzomwedzi kunofadza, kwete kuti kunokuzorodza, nokuti kurarama nenzira yakasiyana, kuchengeta nguva dzako, uye kukumbira kutungamirirwa kana uri mukusava nechokwadi, zvose zvinokubatsira kupedza Ramadan uine rugare.

ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.29: Kushivirira (sabr) hakurevi kusachema kana kuti kusanzwisisa marwadzo; kunogona kungoperera rwendo rwacho nokutenda netariro.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.30: Zvishamiso zviduku zvinogona kubatsira zvishoma nezvishoma kudzorera pfungwa yorugare: kukumbira, nguva yokufunga, kuteerera pakunamata, kana kuti kuvapo kwomudiwa.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.35: Kupora kunoda nguva, uye hapana nguva dzose munhu anogona kupedza kurasikirwa.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.37: Hapana chikonzero chekuita zvose kamwe chete, asi sarudza zvinoenderana nezvaunonzwa uye zvaunoda iye zvino.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.40: Ramba uchiita zvinhu zviduku zvokunamata kana zvichinyaradza
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.41: Tsvaka mazano panyaya ipi neipi yechitendero
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.42: Tsvaka rubatsiro kana kusuruvara kwacho kuchinetsa
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.44: Kuzvichengeta, kutsvaka rutsigiro, uye kuramba uine tariro kunogona kubatsira zvishoma nezvishoma kutungamirira nzira yorugare.

ReligiousFaq.6: Mibvunzo inowanzobvunzwa pamusoro pechikadzi fiqh, yakaungana panzvimbo imwe chete ine mhinduro dzakajeka.
ReligiousFaq.8: AWA haibudisi fatwa kana kutonga kwechitendero kwakagadzirirwa.
ReligiousFaq.14: Mibvunzo yakawanda pamusoro pedzimiriro yenguva, munyengetero, uye kutsanya inouya nguva dzose kubva kumukadzi mumwe nomumwe.
ReligiousFaq.16: Fiqh yevakadzi inounza pamwe chete mitemo inoshanda inobatanidza muviri wevakadzi uye kunamata: kutenderera, kuchena, munyengetero, kutsanya, nifas, uye istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.17: Ndezvipi zvinhu zvikuru zvinobatanidzwa muchikadzi fiqh?
ReligiousFaq.18: Rinonyanya kutaura nezvokutenga uye kutenderera, kuchena kwetsika, ghusl, munyengetero nokutsanya panguva uye pashure pokutenga, nifas, uye istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.19: Musiyano upi uripo pakati pemwedzi, kubuda ropa pashure pokunge mwana aberekwa, uye kubuda ropa kusingawanzoitiki?
ReligiousFaq.20: Mwedzi (hayd) unotevera kutenderera kwakajairika, nifas inoitika mushure mekuberekwa, uye istihâda inoreva kubuda ropa kusiri pamutemo, kunze kwokutenderera.
ReligiousFaq.22: Munyengetero unomiswa panguva ino: unobvumirwa kusunungurwa, kuti uwane pasina mhosva.
ReligiousFaq.23: Chii chinoitika pakuzvinyima zvokudya panguva yokushaya nguva?
ReligiousFaq.24: Kuzvinyima zvokudya kunomiswawo; mazuva asina kuzvinyima zvokudya anoitwa gare gare (qadaa), kunze kweRamadan.
ReligiousFaq.25: Nei minyengetero inenge isina kuitwa ichishandiswa sezvinongoita kutsanya?
ReligiousFaq.26: Kusiyana uku kunokonzerwa nohunhu hwezviito zviviri: munyengetero unoitwa zuva nezuva uye unozodzokororwa, ukuwo kutsanya kunoitwa gore negore uye kunongedzwa mukati memwedzi mumwe chete.
ReligiousFaq.27: Munamato unotangazve rini pashure pokuenda kumwedzi?
ReligiousFaq.28: Pakarepo apo nhambo dzomwedzi dzapera uye ghusl yaitwa, munyengetero unotangazve nenzira yakajairika, pasina kunonoka.
ReligiousFaq.30: Ghusl ndiro rinokosha rinobvumira munhu kudzokera kumamiriro okuchena kwetsika anodiwa kuti aitezve munyengetero nezvimwe zviito zvokunamata.
ReligiousFaq.31: Chii chaunofanira kuita kana usingazivi kuti nguva yako yekare yapera?
ReligiousFaq.32: Kuona kushayikwa kworopa zvachose kwenguva yakakwana, pane kuvimba nemashoko anongoitika kamwe chete, kunobatsira kujekesa mamiriro acho ezvinhu.
ReligiousFaq.33: Kunamata kwakasiyana-siyana kunogona kuitwa here panguva yokusununguka?
ReligiousFaq.34: Hungu: dhikr, kukumbira, rudo, kudzidza kwechitendero, uye zvimwe zviito zvomutsa zvichiri kuwanika.
ReligiousFaq.35: Nei mhinduro dzingava dzakasiyana zvichienderana nemamiriro ezvinhu?
ReligiousFaq.36: Fiqh inzvimbo yokududzira: maonero anogona kusiyana zvichienderana nechikoro chemutemo uye mamiriro ezvinhu evanhu, pasina maonero ega ega ari echokwadi.
ReligiousFaq.37: Islamic fiqh inosanganisira kusiyana kwakagamuchirwa kwekududzira pane dzimwe pfungwa dzakajeka.
ReligiousFaq.38: Zvichienderana nemunhu waunotsvaka, mubvunzo mumwe chete unogona kugamuchira mhinduro dzakasiyana zvishoma. Izvi hazvirevi kuti mhinduro yacho yaizova yakashata: inoratidza maitiro akasiyana uye kuverenga kwemashoko akafanana.
ReligiousFaq.40: Kutevera munhu ane unyanzvi nguva dzose, pane kuramba uchishandura pfungwa zvichibva pamhinduro ipi neipi inowanikwa, kunobatsira kuchengeta tsika yako yakajeka uye yakadzikama.
ReligiousFaq.41: Mamwe mamiriro ezvinhu anoramba akaoma kugadzirisa achibva pane tsanangudzo imwe chete yakajairika.
ReligiousFaq.42: Pane kusava nechokwadi pamusoro pokuti nguva yokugara pamwedzi yakaguma riini
ReligiousFaq.43: Hunhu hwekupera ropa hunoramba husina chokwadi (kuenda kumwedzi, istihâda, zvimwe)
ReligiousFaq.44: Kusava nechokwadi kunoramba kuripo pamusoro pokudikanwa kwekuita ghusl
ReligiousFaq.45: Nyaya yokudzokorora munyengetero inoramba isina chokwadi
ReligiousFaq.48: Kana mamiriro ezvinhu ari omunhu oga, akaoma kunzwisisa, kana kuti anopfuurira, haagoni kugadziriswa neruzivo rwomunhu oga. Kuenda kunyanzvi ine unyanzvi, inokwanisa kufunga nezvemamiriro ako ezvinhu chaiwo, kunoramba kuri nzira yakanakisisa mumamiriro ezvinhu akadaro. AWA haibudisi fatwa kana kuti kutonga kwechitendero kwakanyatsogadzirirwa.
ReligiousFaq.49: Fiqh yevakadzi inobatanidza zvinhu zvakawanda zvetsika dzechitendero chevakadzi
ReligiousFaq.50: Mamwe mashoko anogona kusiyanisa zviri pamutemo zvichienderana nechikoro chemutemo
ReligiousFaq.51: Mashoko akajairika haatsivi nhungamiro dzechitendero dzakagadzirirwa munhu oga
ReligiousFaq.52: Kusava nechokwadi kunoramba kuripo kunofanira kukurukurwa nomudzidzi ane unyanzvi
